chunks: Hammad narrated from Al-Halabi, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:
If any man attacks another man to strike him, and the latter defends himself and injures or kills the attacker, then there is nothing upon him.

key_terms.فَلَا شَيْءَ عَلَيْهِ: there is no liability upon him

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone injures or kills an attacker while defending himself?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on self-defense. If a person is attacked and, while defending himself, wounds or kills the aggressor, no liability is upon the defender in this case.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5189 - Hammad narrated from Al-Halabi from Abu Abdullah (as), who said:
"If any man attacks another man to strike him, and the latter defends himself and injures or kills the attacker, then there is nothing upon him (no liability)."
